- Slightly reduced enemy damage across the board. (15% drop in 0 star raids, and 7% drop in the rest.)

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed some visual issues with the tutorial.
- Heroes can no longer be sent to take breaks and rest during the tutorial.
- Pinning a crafting popup will now carry over the status of the autocraft as well.
- Some of Ventura's tips were appearing before they should have.
- Fixed a potential issue where rooms couldn't be expanded. (Didn't see it happening, but it seems like it should have been.)

Thanks.

notes.title: The Heroes for Hire Demo is now live!
notes.content:
The Heroes For Hire Demo is now live, with a massive overhaul to a lot of the game's functions compared to the playtest. Thanks everyone who tested. Keep in mind, the game is still in active development and I still plan on pushing out patches, just not at the rate that the playtest went through.

Post any feedback and error reports in the steam forums, and I'll try to get to them. Thanks.


0.2.0.0

Additions:
- Training Halls are now called Gymnasiums and can now be upgraded! At 1.25 training rating, they're now upgraded to Intermediate and at 4.0, Advanced.
- Level 2 and 3 skills now must be unlocked by training at an Intermediate and Advanced Gymnasium respectively. If already unlocked, skills can now be rerolled by retraining. (Always found that there was little reason to unlock and upgrade training halls, hopefully this remedies that.)
- Added a couple more tips.
- Dragging a shortcut pin to the hero list or item storage will now filter out heroes/items for what's on the shortcut.
- Added some tooltips to show some of the things that can be clicked to open other stuff up.
- Added a shortcut to the merchant requirements guide on the shop list.
- When wages and rent are changed, an alert now notifies the player.
- Happier heroes will now try and share potions with the rest of the team.
- Added some visual indicators for when heroes are happy and unhappy.

Balance:
- Adjusted the amount of items asked for by orders.
- Changed the way that the Helmbreaker skill reduces defence.
- The game now starts at 10AM instead of Noon. Also tweaked some starting values so that hero sleep schedules line up better.
- During tournament and skirmish battles, hero weapons no longer have unique attributes.
- The guild rating can no longer drop below 0.
- Pharaoh Tensis will now wait longer after trying to summon locusts.
- Raid Boss HP now scales more with more heroes in the raid.
- Orders now unlock after 3 raids, rather than after 5.
- Heroes will now get madder when they aren't allowed to take a break.
- Reduced the amount of extra orders you get from having extra notice boards. You'll get more unique orders, though.
- Merging potions no longer requires the workshop level to make them in the first place.
- Heroes will now try to run away from raids more often if they don't have a potion in their inventory.
- Starting a raid before letting heroes relax now only impacts mood rather than happiness.

Other Changes:
- Tweaked the items you start with in the tutorial.
- It's now actually possible to unlock Advanced training halls. They unlock at 4.0 training rating as well.
- Changed how gathered materials work, the gathered materials will be what is shown on the popup all the time.
- Added keyboard controls to the pause menu.
- Heroes can no longer catch illness from other heroes and be cured at the same time. The chance of being cured has been made higher to compensate.
- Players are now warned when heroes about to start a raid don't have full health.
- Players will no longer be left without at least one slime and cave raid on the first day.
- Modified the starting tutorial even further.
- Added a preview to the initial setup.
- Changed how the hero raid auto setup picks heroes.
- Ventura's text bubble at the bottom of the screen has been made bigger.
- Popup size is now consistent between new popups.
- An indicator for boss enemies has been added.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where hero thoughts would display out of order.
- Rival guilds with crossbows no longer have the javelin skill and visa versa.
- Fixed some visual issues with a couple furniture models.
- Fixed the behaviour of pins if popups were overlapping them.
- Dragging objects and heroes into rooms while the guild hall popup is open no longer makes rooms.
- The "Get The Ball Rolling" popup no longer needs to be open to finish it.
- Fixed a bug where chairs near tables were still losing stats.
- (Hopefully) Fixed a bug where popups would randomly lock up after playing long enough.
- Fixed a potential overflow issue caused by some popups not clearing properly.
- Recruited heroes will no longer have one more stat than they should have.
- It is no longer possible to build outside of the guild hall popup.
- Fixed a couple misaligned pieces of text.
- Fixed the "Are You Sure?" warning for changing settings not doing anything ingame.
- Starting a raid wasn't impacting sleeping and off shift heroes, and now it does.
- Fixed an issue with the item storage during the tutorial.
- Raider's Digest medals are no longer called Basic Bed ingames.
- Hero wage wasn't impacting happiness in a way that it should have been, and now does.
- Fixed an issue related to saving hero shortcut pins.
- Fixed an issue with loading related to hero health, and the bodyguard's health.
- Fixed slime nodes giving weapons in an extremely rare scenario.

notes.title: Heroes For Hire has updated to 0.1.7.0!
notes.content:
0.1.7.0

This is the last planned playtest patch, as the demo content for the most part is complete. Unless a major bug and crash is found, the playtest is going to be taken down in a week until the demo launches. Thanks for testing Heroes For Hire, the feedback has been really helpful.

Additions:
- Enemy tournament/rival weapons can now contain gems and have differing qualities.

Other Changes:
- Raids will no longer automatically start if one of the heroes is sick.
- The room building system that the guild hall uses has been changed. You can now build rooms anywhere in the raid, and the guild boundaries will expand and contract as necessary.
- It is now only possible to run one skirmish at a time.
- It is now possible to spectate the current skirmish if the popup is closed off.
- Selecting "maximize" during setup will now actually maximize the screen.
- The order of operations for automatic crafting and selling is now based on the vertical position of the popup and pin, from top to bottom. (Already works this way for raiding, gathering and training.)

Balance: 
- The Bodyguard now has only neutral personality traits.
- The Bodyguard now only uses a sword, before was using randomly generated weapons each turn.
- Reduced the amount of healing done by the sapphire gem.
- Rival vs Rival battles during tournaments should now be more accurate.
- A couple enemy attacks targeted random heroes even if the hero was dead. This is no longer the case.
- Rebalanced some of the furniture items.

Bug Fixes:
- Autofilling a startraid popup with an empty fourth hero slot will now always add the Bodyguard if he is in your guild and is not raiding.
- Fixed a bug where the Bodyguard would occasionally not have a weapon.
- It is no longer possible to open up the Bodyguard's hero info popup using the raid list.
- Fixed a crash caused by trying to fire a hero.
- Fixed a crash caused by the "Pumped Up" skill.
- Fixed a crash caused by overworking a hero.
- Fixed a crash caused by the hero shortcut pin.
- Fixed a bug where the crafting menu wasn't actually checking to see if you had the right items when the actual item was being crafted.

notes.title: Heroes For Hire has been Updated to 0.1.6.0!
notes.content:
0.1.6.0

Additions:
- Added a button to create shortcut pins to the item storage and hero list.

Other Changes:
- Changed how hero recruitment is unlocked. Previously, by dragging the guest room bed into the hero lodge, it could be unlocked earlier than it should have been which may have been throwing people off. A bed must now be crafted first. (Unless a hero dies, then it unlocks as a failsafe.)
- Orders are now unlocked upon completion of five raids instead of after the tutorial.
- Tweaked some parts of the tutorial even further.
- Increased the amount of time until the idle sound muting kicks in.
- Only small sized raids now spawn on the first day.
- Tweaked the timing of some advice tips.
- The Merchant will no longer sell gold and silver bars past day 2 of the new audit, instead selling clumps and dust.
- Ventura's alerts will now appear less, and a lot of the alerts that used to make icons flash no longer do.
- Clicking off the bank/shop/services/recruitment tutorial while each service is closed will no longer consider the tutorial complete.
- Training and Gathering will now warn you if a hero is sick before letting them go off to train or gather.
- Double clicking the raid info box will no longer open the guide during the tutorial.

Balance:
- Resource nodes are now more likely to spawn on critical raid paths.
- To compensate, resources are now less likely to be gathered in raids.
- Tired heroes now have a chance to navigate raids in the wrong way.
- Tweaked how much notice boards increase the amount of recruitment offers can be sent out at once, and made it so it's impossible to pay extra for the same amount of recruitment offers.
- Heroes standing around during raids no longer impact the performance rating for the audit as much.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed a crash caused by making a shop autosell pin.
- Also fixed a crash caused by making a shortcut pin.
- Fixed some localization misalignments.
- Fixed the end of day message not showing the proper numbers.
- Trying to buy or sell one piece of clothing or weapon to a store will no longer claim that you aren't selling or buying anything.
- Fixed some visual inconsistencies with the end of day popup.
- Fixed some the strange text scaling on menus and the end of day visual.
- Fixed a corruption on save files related to saving with a project running.
- Fixed saving the tournament potentially saving hero ids wrong.
- Fixed a bug where the hero sidebar wasn't showing every hero on the list.
- Fixed a bug where the dragging from the herolist popup wasn't grabbing the right hero.
- The autosell pin now saves properly.
- Autocrafting now only triggers the speedup if an item was successfully crafted.
- Fixed a misalignment with skill effects on the raid pin.
- Fixed a bug where deleting room tiles would put heroes in that room in a corrupted blank room.

notes.title: Heroes For Hire has been updated to 0.1.4.0!
notes.content:
The first "big" update for Heroes For Hire! This update was rushed out a bit faster than I wanted, as I noticed some stuff during feedback and testing that I wanted to try and remedy. I noticed that players aren't doing more than 1 or 2 raids, but at the same time are crafting new clothing.

This makes me think that the advisor popup is working when it comes to guidance, but players don't know to do more raids to get materials. This update should help that by making sure the tutorial isn't finished when all heroes are asleep, and that the goal doesn't get lost in the sea of new icons to mess with.

During testing previously, I found out that the game has a bunch of downtime early on, and that could turn players away. This downtime shrinks the more that's played, so it's hard to just "speed" the game up. Hopefully balance fixes help with this without making the game too overwhelming later on.

Anyways, here are the patch notes.

[b]Additions:[/b]
- Added a new dungeon type!

[u]Sandy Tombs:[/u]
- The resting place for an ancient pharaoh, filled with spooky spirits and poisonous critters, and also the best place to get sand for glass. This dungeon is one star at minimum, like the pirate dungeon.

[u]New Enemies:[/u]
- Scorpion: A strong and slow monster that has a poisonous stinger.
- Emperor Scorpion: An upgraded version of the scorpion.
- Cobra: A fast, strong but flimsy monster that has a poisonous bite.
- King cobra: An upgraded version of the cobra.
- Centipede: A fast but weak monster that can bind heroes.
- Genie: A strong and slow monster that can apply a random effect, and hide in a pot when threatened.
- Mummy: Effectively the tomb equivalent of the spirit in the pirate map.
- Scarab: A weak, but fast beetle that can form a swarm that increases strength and speed.
- Scarab Swarm: A swarm of scarabs that can call even more scarabs into its swarm.
- Pharaoh Tensis: The boss of this tomb. Can curse the entire team, and summon a plague of locusts.
- Locust: A weak and slow locust that can eat hero potions right out of their inventory.

- Guide entries for the new enemies have not been added, and neither have the associated boss furniture. They'll be added in a future update.

[b]Balance[/b]
